Name: Cakes With Cake
Author: MakoKZ
Description:
I can't believe this is how I break my hiatus...
I was minding my own business when I was plagued with a thought. A terrible thought that I knew had to be done else I keep thinking about it and be, eventually, driven to complete and utter ruin...
Although we may be given hands upon which to create things, I fear that some creations are beyond our mere ken. And so, I spent 10 minutes drawing butts on pixel art cakes and making a mod of it.

Tagged NSFW just in case. It's just cakes with a butt drawn on them, that's all this is. Please don't download this, I beg of you.

Spam Mail update coming soon.

Requires Content Patcher. Maintaining this mod never. I have released this beast onto the world, it may now do as it pleases. We are simply at its mercy.
